body.p: How the dog looked for a master. Once upon a time, a dog lived alone in the forest. The dog didn't want to live alone. It went to look for a master in the forest. It walked, walked and met a hare. The dog says to it:"Hare, let's live together." The hare said: "Okay, let's live together". They found a place, when the night fell, they fell asleep. The hare fell asleep, the dog was awake, suddenly it barked. The hare woke up, it got up, so it told the dog: "Who are you barking at now? The wolf will hear, come here, and eat us." The dog fell silent, thought to himself: "My master turns out to be bad, he's afraid of the wolf. As for the wolf, it is not afraid of anyone." The dog left the hare, it went to look for the wolf. It walked, walked and met the wolf. It said: "Wolf, let's live together". The wolf said:"Well, let's live." The night well, the wolf fell asleep, but the dog again had no sleep, it started barking. The wolf woke up, got up and spoke to the dog: "Why are you barking? The bear will hear, come here and eat us.[ShA:] I assume that Ð½ÑÑÐ¸Ð¹ is a mistake. The dog thinks: "This one has no force, as well, it is afraid of the bear." It left to look for a bear. Soon it will find this one. So it said to it: "Grandfather-bear, let's live together, huh?" "Well, let's live". The night fell, the bear fell asleep, the dog again had no sleep and started barking. The bear stood up and said: "Why are you crying, dog, the human will hear, come here and kill us." The dog thinks: "This one again has someone to be afraid of, I will go to look for a human."[ShA:] A more expected form should be enÄedonÊ¼iÊ. It walked, walked, walked out of the forest and sat down to have a rest.At this time, a man left the house to get firewood. At the border of the forest the dog saw the human and said: "Human, let's live together." The human said: "Go with me." The human brought the dog to his home. The night fell, the human fell down. In the middle of the night, the dog started barking, but the human was sleeping. After that the dog started barking more loudly. The human woke up and said to the dog: "Why are you barking? If you are hungry, eat, but let me sleep." The dog fell silent, ate the soup, fell asleep. So it stayed to live with the human. This is the end (of the story).[ShA:] A more expected form is enÄegon.
